If you currently use the Sources or Tokens API, see [migrating to PaymentIntents]

old_evidence.text: Some bank redirects don’t support recurring payments.

findings: New raw lines 5-19 and old raw lines 4-18 retain the bank-account redirect flow and return to merchant site after customer approval, with possible two-factor bank authentication. New raw line 14 frames subscriptions positively as method-specific support; old raw line 13 warned some methods do not support recurring. Neither sentence authorizes treating all bank redirects as reusable, and a browser return alone is not proof of payment settlement.

The November product table (new raw lines 25-34) lists six methods, dropping TWINT from the seven-row older product table (old raw lines 24-34). The November API table (new raw lines 40-50) lists seven methods, dropping TWINT from the eight-row older API table (old raw lines 40-51), while Pay by Bank remains API-only within this overview. An omitted row does not prove TWINT support was removed across Stripe; current source lines 13,18,37, concept lines 10,25, and wiki/stripe-index.md lines 266,744 preserve eight-method May history but must not describe that as November table coverage. The index labels need reciprocal dated scope: six November product rows, seven API rows, with Pay by Bank only in the API table.

BLIK changes most visibly: old product row raw line 27 says subscription, invoicing and Customer Portal unsupported and Checkout footnotes 1,2; new raw line 28 marks all three products supported and omits Checkout footnotes 1,2. Old API row raw line 43 says SetupIntents and setup_future_usage unsupported; new raw line 43 marks both supported. Footnote 1 at new raw line 50 gives a broad family distinction, while the BLIK-specific raw stripe-payments-blik-2026-11-07.md lines 124-148,160-181 explicitly scopes reusable mandates to off-session use and gated Connect capabilities. The matrix shift is material but must be qualified by method-specific eligibility. Current source lines 20,23-24,31 and concept lines 19,32-34 are stale.

New BLIK product row raw line 28 still labels Mobile Payment Element supported, but the same-date BLIK method page raw stripe-payments-blik-2026-11-07.md lines 150-175 marks in-app payments unsupported. The terms may not be fully identical, but this apparent UI-support inconsistency needs an explicit warning before relying on the overview's mobile cell. The BLIK method page lines 177-181 requires active blik_payments and, for recurring, blik_recurring_payments capabilities on platform and connected account; the overview matrix alone is not account-eligibility proof.

New Bancontact API row raw lines 42,50 marks SetupIntents unsupported but setup_future_usage supported through a generated SEPA Direct Debit method. The old API row raw line 42 marked both supported. The same-date Bancontact method page raw stripe-payments-bancontact-2026-11-07.md lines 109-116 marks both SetupIntents and Payment Intents with setup_future_usage unsupported. The new overview and method page conflict on future-use support; distinguish native single-use Bancontact from generated SEPA method, and do not silently pick an implementation route. Current source line 30 and concept line 18 retain the older SetupIntent yes claim as undated.

Non-BLIK retained product cells still carry constraints: EPS/FPX/P24 Checkout excludes subscription and setup modes by footnotes 1,2 (new raw lines 29-34); Bancontact/EPS/FPX/P24 subscription entries use send_invoice only by footnote 7, with invite-only invoicing for Bancontact/EPS/P24 and FPX supported (new raw lines 27-34). iDEAL|Wero subscription is Checkout-subscription-mode-only, no charge_automatically for subscription/invoice, and send_invoice footnotes apply (new raw lines 31-34). Product support must not be flattened to generic recurring or all Checkout modes.

The API table new raw lines 40-50 keeps all listed methods on PaymentIntents and manual capture unsupported; BLIK alone is redirect-free, while other listed methods require redirect. Footnote 2 qualifies return_url as possibly needed for confirmation; new BLIK footnote 4 retains its deferred-intent exclusion. Source line 39 states off_session-only as a general supported-bank-redirect rule, but raw footnote 1 says non-card/bank-debit methods either lack setup_future_usage or only support off_session; avoid extending it to an unlisted method or all Account contexts.

Current source lines 17-18 says all eight methods support Connect, Checkout, Payment Links, Payment Element and Mobile Payment Element, yet neither pinned product matrix contains a Pay by Bank row (old raw lines 24-32; new raw lines 25-32). This is a baseline summary overclaim independent of the November changes. The source line 21's 'iDEAL|Wero only' subscription wording is ambiguous because Bancontact/EPS/FPX/P24 also have send_invoice-only subscription support (new raw lines 27-34; old raw lines 26-34).

New raw line 19 changes the diagram path from an older local asset at old raw line 18 to Stripe CDN; new raw line 34 changes a BLIK footnote quickstart link. These are presentation/navigation; the substantive shifts are BLIK cells, Bancontact SetupIntent cell, TWINT omission and subscription framing. The method overview includes no payment-intent state machine, mandate details or live account test.

Main route wiki/index.md lines 5-7 to wiki/stripe-index.md lines 266,744 to wiki/concepts/stripe-bank-redirects.md lines 8-39. Concept and the two Stripe index labels at lines 266,744 retain older eight-method matrix language; BLIK no-setup/no-recurring claims also need reciprocal date/version scope. Mapped source frontmatter lines 1-9 lacks canonical_url and only old raw provenance, so add trusted URL and November capture while retaining May raw.
substantive_changes: BLIK product support shifts from unsupported subscription, invoicing and Customer Portal to supported and drops Checkout setup/subscription-mode exclusion footnotes (old raw line 27 versus new raw line 28); BLIK SetupIntents and setup_future_usage shift from unsupported to supported in the API matrix (old raw line 43 versus new raw line 43).

Bancontact SetupIntents cell shifts supported to unsupported (old raw line 42 versus new raw line 42), while its setup_future_usage remains supported with newly explicit generated-SEPA footnote (new raw line 50); same-date Bancontact method page conflicts on future use.
TWINT rows appear in old product/API matrices (old raw lines 32,49) but not the November matrices (new raw lines 25-32,40-49); this changes captured coverage, not proven product withdrawal.
historical_claims_to_preserve: 2026-05-03 old raw lines 13,24-34: caution on subscriptions and seven product rows including TWINT, with BLIK subscription/invoicing/portal and Checkout setup/subscription mode unsupported.
2026-05-03 old raw lines 40-51: eight API rows including TWINT; Bancontact SetupIntents yes and BLIK SetupIntents/setup_future_usage no as dated matrix facts.
2026-05-03 old raw lines 26-34,42-51: bank-specific send_invoice, invite-only, redirect/manual-capture, off_session and deferred-intent footnotes retain their historical scope.
2026-05-03 old raw lines 15-18 and 53-55: redirect diagram local asset and migration navigation are evidence of the older page, not November support proof.
conflicts: Current source lines 13,18,37, concept lines 10,25, and wiki/stripe-index.md lines 266,744 present an eight-method matrix including TWINT, but new raw lines 25-32,40-49 omit it; date all source, concept and index labels to May coverage and do not infer actual TWINT deprecation.

Current source lines 20,23-24,31 and concept lines 19,32-34 retain BLIK no subscription/invoicing/portal/setup/future-use, while new raw lines 28,43 say supported; BLIK method-page recurring mandate/capability details at raw stripe-payments-blik-2026-11-07.md lines 124-148,177-181 qualify this.

Current source line 30 and concept line 18 say Bancontact SetupIntents supported from old raw line 42, while new overview raw line 42 says unsupported; same-date Bancontact method page raw lines 112-114 also says SetupIntents and setup_future_usage unsupported, but new overview raw lines 42,50 says setup_future_usage supported through SEPA. Carry both dated and same-date contradictions.

Source line 18 all-eight product-support claim cannot be established by either product table because Pay by Bank appears only in API rows (old raw lines 24-32,48; new raw lines 25-32,48). This is a baseline summary accuracy error.
Overview BLIK Mobile Payment Element supported at new raw line 28 versus BLIK-specific in-app unsupported at same-date method page raw line 158; UI terminology and support need reconciliation.
unresolved_questions: Does the November omission of TWINT reflect table scope, temporary documentation absence or actual support change? Neither pinned overview resolves it.

What is the current Bancontact future-use/SetupIntent route given November overview raw lines 42,50 and same-date method page raw lines 112-114? Which BLIK mobile surface is intended by the conflicting cells?
The matrices provide documentation support labels, not account capability activation, runtime payment success or subscription authorization for a particular merchant.

findings: Add trusted canonical_url and November raw provenance to source frontmatter (source lines 1-9,43-45), preserving May raw and its eight-row API history.

Revise BLIK product and API support claims at source lines 20,23-24,31 using new raw lines 28,43 and retain May matrix as dated; footnote and BLIK method-page capability qualifiers prevent a universal eligibility claim.

Distinguish November's six product/seven API rows and TWINT absence from May's seven/eight rows (new raw lines 25-32,40-49; old raw lines 24-32,40-49). Correct source lines 13,18,37 all-eight wording and the baseline unsupported Pay by Bank product inference.

Scope Bancontact SetupIntent/future-use facts at source line 30 to the conflicting old/new overview and same-date Bancontact method page (old raw line 42; new raw lines 42,50; method-page lines 109-116). Do not settle the conflict from this overview alone.
Retain method-specific send_invoice, invite-only, Checkout-mode, manual-capture and redirect qualifications at new raw lines 25-50; status labels are not payment or eligibility evidence.

Qualify both discoverable Stripe index routes at wiki/stripe-index.md lines 266 and 744: their eight-method labels reflect May API coverage (old raw lines 40-49) but the November capture has six product rows (new raw lines 25-32) and seven API rows (new raw lines 40-48). TWINT is absent in November without proven withdrawal; Pay by Bank is an API row only in both captures, not established product-table support.
conflicts: Source lines 20,23-24,31 stale BLIK support versus new raw lines 28,43.
Source line 30 Bancontact SetupIntent yes versus new raw line 42 no; new overview future-use yes at lines 42,50 versus same-date method page no at lines 112-114.
Source lines 13,18,37 eight-method/all-product claim versus November rows and Pay by Bank baseline gap.
New raw line 28 BLIK Mobile Payment Element supported versus same-date BLIK method page line 158 in-app unsupported.

wiki/stripe-index.md lines 266,744 unqualified eight-method overview labels can be read as November table coverage, contrary to new raw lines 25-32,40-48; the old raw lines 24-32,40-49 give dated seven-product/eight-API coverage.
source_assessments.reason: The new overview materially changes BLIK and Bancontact API/product cells and narrows table coverage. The mapped source, concept and both main Stripe index routes need dated scope; its older all-eight product-support claim also overstates Pay by Bank, which appears only in the API table. Add reciprocal method-page conflicts without claiming live rollout, deprecation or payment outcome.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/bank-redirects, new raw lines 5-19 describe the usual bank-account checkout redirect to a banking portal, authentication and return, while BLIK is the redirect-free exception at new raw line 43; neither a return nor code entry is settlement proof. The product and API matrices at new raw lines 21-50 give method-specific Connect, Checkout, subscription/invoice, SetupIntent, future-use, manual-capture and redirect labels with footnotes. BLIK gains supported subscriptions, invoicing, Customer Portal, SetupIntents and setup_future_usage in this capture, whereas old raw lines 24-51 mark those unsupported; Bancontact SetupIntents moves from yes to no. TWINT appears only in the older rows. source-stripe-bank-redirects.md and wiki/stripe-index.md lines 266,744 summarize the May eight-method API view but now has stale BLIK/Bancontact cells and an all-eight product claim that neither table supports for Pay by Bank. Capability labels do not establish account eligibility or a successful payment.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/bank-redirects, the material visible changes are BLIK support cells, Bancontact SetupIntents, and TWINT's omission from this capture (old raw lines 24-51; new raw lines 25-50), plus a softened subscription framing. The CDN flow image, table padding and quickstart link are presentation/navigation. source-stripe-bank-redirects.md and wiki/stripe-index.md lines 266,744 must retain the dated May TWINT, BLIK and Bancontact matrix while recording November's six product and seven API rows, with Pay by Bank only in the API table, correction of its baseline all-eight product overclaim, and the same-date Bancontact overview-versus-method-page future-use conflict. BLIK remains redirect-free (new raw line 43) and its product row needs recurring capability and UI qualifications, since its method page conflicts on mobile support; Checkout footnotes, send_invoice, invite-only, off_session and return_url limits remain method-specific. No row omission proves deprecation, no browser return proves payment success, and no matrix cell establishes an active merchant capability.
